build.beforeBuildCommand: cd wasm && wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir ../web/src/wasm-pkg && cd ../web && pnpm build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' ws: wss: http: https:; font-src 'self' data:
